title: The Invisible Run
description: Rowan runs wide as Mercer shifts and North drops. Linden finds Voss, who controls and shoots quickly with Pike and Mercer closing, then turns toward the corner as teammates follow.

events.label: The buildup
events.detail: Linden advances at a purposeful jog while Aurora's supporting players move forward.

events.label: The invisible run
events.detail: Rowan accelerates diagonally wide, with Mercer shifting and North dropping toward the runner.

events.label: Defender shifts
events.detail: North takes the wide route. Mercer starts recovering inside and Pike narrows toward Voss.

events.label: Through the channel
events.detail: Linden releases the diagonal pass through the inside-right channel as Pike accelerates toward the receiver.

events.label: Voss receives
events.detail: Voss cushions the pass while moving. Pike closes from inside and Mercer recovers from the wide channel.

events.label: The finish
events.detail: After one settling touch, Voss shoots across goal with Pike and Mercer still closing.

events.label: Goal · Aurora
events.detail: The whole ball crosses inside the posts. Voss turns toward the attacking corner as Rowan, Linden and Sol converge.
